settings_signin_sso: You sign in as {#em}{email}{/em} with single sign-on. To also have a password, ask an admin for a password link.

settings_sessions_description: Devices currently signed in to your account

settings_import_key_hint_admin: A personal key (starts with uk-) also brings your private scenes.
settings_import_key_hint_member: Use a personal key (starts with uk-).

settings_import_error_admins_only: Only admins can import shared collections
settings_import_error_workspace_key: A workspace key can't read your private scenes. Use a personal key (uk-…).
settings_import_error_unreadable: Excalidraw+ sent data this import can't read

settings_import_files_description: Add .excalidraw files from your computer. They go to Private. PNG and SVG exports that include the scene work too. To put files in a folder or in Team, open it and drop them on the drawings, or drop them on it in the sidebar.
settings_import_files_drop: Drop files here, or click to choose
settings_tokens_description: Connect an AI client such as Claude Code over MCP. A token sees what you see and can create and trash drawings as you.
settings_tokens_copy_description: You won't see it again. Anyone with it can read your drawings and create new ones as you, until you revoke it.
settings_tokens_new_description: Name it after the client or device that will use it.
settings_apps_description: Apps you signed in to Excaliself, such as a Claude.ai connector. They have the same access as a token.
settings_invites_description: Single-use links that add a member. Each expires after 7 days — copy a pending link to send it again.
settings_members_last_admin: The last admin can't be demoted.
settings_members_reset_copied: Reset link copied — single-use, valid for 24 hours
settings_members_reset_copy_failed: Couldn't copy the reset link — generate it again
settings_members_counts_failed: Couldn't load {name}'s content counts. Close this dialog and try again.

settings_members_confirm_empty: This will delete {name}'s account. They have no drawings or folders.
settings_members_confirm_empty_team: This will delete {name}'s account. They have no private drawings or folders.

match.countPlural=one: Their {count} Team drawing stays with the team.
match.countPlural=*: Their {count} Team drawings stay with the team.

settings_members_demote_description: You'll immediately lose access to instance settings like members and invites. Another admin would have to promote you back.
settings_sessions_sign_out_others_failed: Couldn't sign out all other sessions
drawings_import_supported: Drop .excalidraw files, or .png and .svg exports that include the scene.

trash_empty_state_team: Nothing in Team trash. Any member can restore what lands here within 30 days.
move_description: All members can see and edit it. You can't move it back to Private.
move_description_contents: All members can see and edit it. You can't move it back to Private. This also moves the {contents} inside it.
share_audience_members_hint: Visitors must sign in before they can open it.
share_audience_anyone_hint: No account needed — guests pick a display name.
share_description_team_shared: Anyone with this link can edit, live. No account needed.

share_description_shared: Everyone with this link can edit, live.
share_description: Create a link that lets others edit this drawing with you, live.
share_stopped_team: The link is dead. Guests can no longer open it.
share_stopped_private: The link is dead and the drawing is private again.
share_regenerated_description: The old link no longer works.

copy_failed: Couldn't copy — select the text and copy it manually

tour_share_body: Share sends a link to draw together, live. Members of this instance can join, and guests too if you allow it.

drawing_room_refused_description: Your changes aren't being saved. Reload the page to try again.

drawing_scene_unreadable_shared: Its saved data is damaged, so your changes aren't being saved. Stop sharing to edit it on your own.
drawing_corrupt_title: This drawing's saved data couldn't be read
drawing_corrupt_description: It opened as an empty canvas. Auto-save is paused so the stored data isn't overwritten.
drawing_trashed_purge_today: This drawing will be permanently deleted today.

match.countPlural=one: This drawing will be permanently deleted in {count} day.
match.countPlural=*: This drawing will be permanently deleted in {count} days.

collab_image_rate_limited_description: Wait a minute, then add the image again.

library_error_full: The team library is full ({max} MB). Remove some items to add more.

comments_error_too_long: Comments can be up to {max} characters.

app_tagline: Your team's whiteboard, on your server.
app_not_found_hint: The page you're looking for doesn't exist

oauth_can_propose: Propose changes to drawings, which you apply or discard
oauth_can_trash: Move drawings and folders to the trash
oauth_cannot: It can't change a drawing without your Apply, or delete anything for good
oauth_return_note: Then you go back to {#em}{host}{/em}. Disconnect it at any time in Settings, under MCP.
